name: The Razorform
description:
About This Game

The Razorform is a story driven action game that blends intense top-down shooter action with dynamic cinematic angles for a gameplay experience like no other. Players can seamlessly switch between military-themed gunplay and sci-fantasy hack-and-slash blade combat.

FEATURES

Story Campaign

Infiltrate a secret research facility weaponizing the Razorform's power. Unravel the truth of its origins, as you venture through a void of despair and death, in search of ultimate redemption.

Uniquely Addictive Combat Loop

The Razorform merges multiple genres in ways that make it truly unique. No other game matches its fusion of camera angles, weaponry, and combat tactics. Shoot, cloak, grenade, roll, transform, parry, slash, teleport, and devise advanced strategies to efficiently defeat enemies.

Deep Story and Lore

Push your gameplay and intellectual skills to the limit as you dive deeper into the Razorform's lore and origins. Join the community discussion to discover and analyze cryptic information on the classified military experiments that unleashed this chaos on the world, and the individuals who paid the ultimate price to harness its power.
short_desc: Infiltrate a classified research facility and unleash the Razorform, a time-warping entity from a dimension of nightmares and chaos. Spray gunfire, uncover military secrets, and slice through enemies with electrified blades. The Razorform is a single player atmospheric sci-fi action game.
